channel.title: Peter Farrar Portraits — Journal
channel.description: Portrait photography insights, session stories and inspiration from Peter Farrar Portraits, Basingstoke, Hampshire.

item.title: Back Online Built Better
item.description: After an outage and frustrating email misses and delays, I have moved the portrait site to a more secure and responsive setup. The training page is now live, with practical photography and business training designed to make sure you retain what you learn.

item.title: Photography Training That Builds Confidence
item.description: Practical photography training designed to help you understand your camera, improve your technique and develop greater confidence in creating better photographs.

item.title: Scotland Through a Photographer's Eyes
item.description: A photographer's holiday around Broughty Ferry and Dundee, capturing coastal views, reflections, boats, changing light and the everyday scenes that make Scotland so enjoyable to photograph.

item.title: Backstage with En Vogue
item.description: A backstage pass in Charlotte, North Carolina around 2012 put me face to face with Cindy Herron of En Vogue. This is the story behind the image and why live music photography was the foundation of everything I do in portraiture today.

item.title: The Power of Professional Makeup
item.description: Professional makeup is not about changing who you are. It is about enhancing your natural features, so you look confident, polished, and at your very best in front of the camera.

item.title: Building Confidence
item.description: Discover how a relaxed portrait session transformed one young woman's confidence. From feeling self conscious about braces to loving over 40 beautiful portraits, see how preparation and trust create natural, authentic photography.

item.title: Basingstoke Portrait Photographer
item.description: I am a portrait photographer based in Basingstoke, creating natural, expressive and honest portraits for individuals, families, performers and professionals across Hampshire.

item.title: Portrait of a Fighter
item.description: A gritty, authentic portrait of a real boxer fresh from sparring, captured with dramatic split lighting and raw intensity.

item.title: A Busy Few Weeks Behind the Scenes
item.description: Learn how automation is helping free up time for photography, plus details on free portrait shoots for aspiring male models.
